data.one_liner: Widget-based animations inspired by Animate.css with zero external dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of customizable widget-based animations inspired by Animate.css. It features two syntaxes (class wrapper and sugar extension methods) and supports infinite loops, manual controllers, and chaining.
use_when: You want to add pre-built entrance, exit, or attention-seeking animations to widgets quickly.
You prefer an animation library with zero external dependencies.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based gesture-driven animations or Rive/Lottie vector animations.
strengths: Supports both class syntax and sugar extension syntax
Easy to chain multiple animations sequentially
weaknesses: Limited to predefined Animate.css-style presets rather than fully custom timeline animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a highly extensible, chainable animation system built directly into extension methods for any widget.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited if you want complex, designer-crafted vector animations from After Effects.
